'''Demo''' was a male [[Mosciive]] right-hand of prince [[Yojan]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Simocadia]]. He was loyal to the prince and supported him in his attempt to destroy the [[Agrocite/Legends|agrocite]] mines with an ancient [[Ardana Shadex]] in order to make both sides of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] lose interest in their planet. Demo informed the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] of this plot in an attempt to stall him for enough time for prince to finish his work and lured him into a valley full of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. Windu, however, choose not to fight the droids and threatened Demo, forcing him to take himself to the prince. The Jedi confronted the prince, who choose to activate the Ardana Shadex, when the Jedi unintentionally destroyed the [[glass key]] - its control module. The giant was awakened an not only crashed the mine, but attempted to destroy the city as well. Windu, Yojan and Demo escaped in a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle]]. Joining their forces against the threat, the Jedi and the prince managed to destroy the giant, by the cost of Yojan's life.
